full_judgment:
Md Emdadul Huq J: This Criminal Appeal under section 30 of the Special Powers Act, 1974 is directed against order dated 27-10-2019 by which Metropolitan Special Tribunal No. 4. Dhaka rejected the bail prayer of the accused-appellant in Metropolitan Special Tribunal Case No. 589 of 2019. 

 7. The case was eventually sent to the Tribunal. The last order dated 13-1-2020 (Annexure-G) shows that the Tribunal has fixed the case for charge hearing on 15-3-2020. 

 8. Earlier in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 15077 of 2019 this appellant was granted bail by a Division Bench of this court presided over by one of us (Mr M Emdadul Huq, J) by judgment anted 22-5-2019 till submission of police-report. There was a further direction in that judgment that after submission of police-report, the court below will be at liberty to consider all the prosecution materials as mentioned in the police-report and to take decision on the bail matter. 

 23. Accused appellant Md Ekramul Hoque @ Babul, son of Mojibul Hoque be enlarged on bail in Metropolitan Special Tribunal Case No. 589 of 2019 arising out of Biman Bandar Police Station Case No. 51 dated 29-7-2018 corresponding to GR Case No. 312 of 2018 till conclusion of the trial in the said case, subject to furnishing bail bond to the satisfaction of the learned Judge of Metropolitan Special Tribunal No. 4; Dhaka. 

 24. The Court below is at liberty to cancel the bail in case of misuse thereof at any stage of the case.
